memory.route.why: the incumbent recall always searches the fixed facts+entities+observations union; it never picks one of the ROUTE options, so there is no comparable answer (its set is kept in memory_s1_decisions.incumbent_label)

*_target.why: the planner's executed target (matched to an element index) is sent for the executed operation's <op>_target question only; the speculative targets of operations it did not choose have no incumbent answer

stuck.why: the planner never answers 'stuck'; the loop's only stall check ends the run before the shadow head runs
